metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the last line, the doorway, Leadenhall, the stores in the passage, and evening prayer.

yesterday: The play is finished. The rule is under the couplet. The account book says Verona ended this day.
Candles are fourpence the pound, and they are yours. The winter stores are the house's, and four shillings was a guess.
Mistress Ansell asked who was punished. You said all of them.
You did not go to the morning rehearsal. At two you were in The Two Gentlemen of Verona.
The book is finished, and you still have it. The company has not read the play.
